# Frontend design (Anthropic)

Push UI work past generic defaults toward a distinctive, deliberate visual design.

- Source: https://github.com/anthropics/skills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/skills/main/skills/frontend-design/SKILL.md
- Author: Anthropic
- License: Apache-2.0
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/frontend-design-anthropic-58f8cf7a

Gives Claude design judgment when building or restyling an interface: picking an aesthetic direction rooted in the subject, choosing typography and color with intent, and avoiding the look of a stock template. It describes a loop of planning, checking against the brief, building and then critiquing the result. It is pure guidance with no scripts, so it works with any framework.

**Try asking:**
- "Design a landing page for my coffee roastery that doesn't look like every SaaS site"
- "Restyle this dashboard so it feels more editorial"
- "Build a portfolio homepage with a bold, unusual layout"
